title: Sophical
description:
Sophical is a story-driven exploration adventure where every card you collect reveals a new piece of a larger mystery.

Travel through a strange world filled with hidden paths, memorable characters, secret rooms, puzzles, and philosophical ideas brought to life. Search every corner for new cards, deckboxes, medals, and powerful artifacts as you gradually uncover the truth behind the Hearts, the Gate, and a force known only as Agape.

Build custom decks from dozens of unique cards inspired by schools of thought, historical thinkers, and competing worldviews. Challenge NPCs to strategic card battles, wager cards, earn rewards, and expand your collection as you journey through interconnected regions.

Along the way you'll encounter optional minigames, hidden achievements, collectible lore, and multiple ways to shape your progress. Every discovery contributes to your overall completion, rewarding thorough exploration and mastery of the world.

Features• Explore a large interconnected world filled with secrets and hidden rewards.

• Collect and discover dozens of unique philosophical cards.

• Build custom decks and challenge NPCs in strategic card battles.

• Earn deckboxes, medals, artifacts, and permanent upgrades.

• Complete card logs, achievement logs, and collection goals.

• Play optional minigames woven into the adventure.

• Uncover a mysterious narrative centered on the Hearts and the Gate.

• Pursue 100% completion through exploration, collection, and mastery.

The deeper you explore, the more the world reveals itself -- and the closer you come to understanding what lies beyond the Gate of Hearts.
description_short: Explore a mysterious interconnected world, collect philosophical cards, build powerful decks, challenge strange characters to card battles, and uncover the secrets of the Hearts in this story-driven adventure.
